comment: The vectors pinning the authority a runner reads from its assignment: Prima.Authority.from_wire/1 of `authority`, the map an assignment carries (Prima.Authority.to_wire/1 with every nil member omitted), and what a reader takes from it, the limits governing the execution (Prima.Limits.to_map/1 of Prima.Authority.limits/1: its bound node's, or the zero limits unbound) and the fields CYFR attaches and never hands the component (Prima.Authority.attached_fields/1: the field-map keys of the projection of every entry the vault binds, the default's and each named account's; a selection (via) or provided configuration projects none), a sorted list. Each `refused` authority is one from_wire/1 refuses in a part a runner reads: the cursor, the bound node's limits, or the projection of the resources' vault or of one of its named accounts. Generated with Prima's constructors (Prima.Authority.root/3 and its child constructors over a parsed Prima.Authority.Blob). Read by apps/prima/test/prima/authority_test.exs and by the Rust runner's crate. A refused case marked unread_by_service is refused in a part a runner reads that a worker service carries unread (the vault's projection): the worker service reads its cursor, its bound node's limits and its resources' egress, and refuses what Prima refuses there. durations are texts read as Prima.Limits.parse_duration/1 reads them, to their milliseconds or null: ms, s, m and h tried in that order and exactly one taken off, or a bare integer of seconds, an integer being an optional sign and ASCII digits of any size. egress are authorities whose resources' egress varies, each read as from_wire/1 reads it to its four lists (an absent or null list none), or null for one it refuses.

read.why: an unbound authority: no policy, no resources, the zero limits
an unbound child of a bound root: its chain and depth, the zero limits
a bound root whose node's limits differ from the defaults in every field, its ingress granting nothing: resources an empty edge
a bound authority whose resources are absent: read as none, its node's limits still its own
a vault entry whose projection names two fields, which CYFR attaches by the names the component reads
named accounts beside the default, each with its own projected fields, and one (Third) projecting none
a bound child through an edge with named accounts: it holds the default binding alone, and its node's limits
a bound child whose call picked the named account Second: that binding alone
a vault selected from another profile (via) projects none
a publisher's provided configuration projects none
a node consenting no memory at all: read as zero, which the runner refuses to run before it fetches the component
durations in each spelling Prima's parser reads: whole seconds with no unit, milliseconds, and a leading plus

refused.why: a bound cursor naming no node of the policy
a bound cursor with no policy
a cursor of another shape: the word bound alone
a cursor of another shape: a bound naming the empty ref
a cursor of another shape: a bound naming a number
a cursor of another shape: a list
a cursor of another shape: absent
a node's limits missing a field
a limit of the wrong JSON type: a byte count as text
a limit of the wrong JSON type: a timeout as a number
a limit of the wrong JSON type: a rate limit's requests as a fraction
a timeout that is no duration
a negative timeout
a duration with two units
a rate limit's window of zero: no window to count in
a node's limits carrying a member Prima does not know
a rate limit carrying a member Prima does not know
a negative byte count
a byte count one past 2^53 - 1, the bound of every integer a canonical blob holds
a rate limit's requests one past 2^53 - 1
the resources' vault whose projection's fields are not an object
a named account whose projection's fields are not an object

egress.why: lists null and absent, read as none
strings kept as written, an empty one and a repeat among them
an egress that is a list
a list that is a string
